nodes.label: API Key Troubleshooting
nodes.rationale: TMDB, RAWG and Google Books keys are obtained from their respective developer consoles.

nodes.label: Environment Variables
nodes.rationale: .env is excluded from git for security, so the hosting platform must hold all five VITE_* variables; names are case-sensitive and a redeploy is needed after adding them.

nodes.label: GitHub Auto-Deploy
nodes.rationale: Every push to main auto-deploys on Vercel or Netlify.

nodes.label: Security Best Practices
nodes.rationale: Env vars for all secrets, .env in .gitignore, separate dev/prod keys, rotate on exposure; never commit .env or hardcode secrets.

nodes.label: Vercel
nodes.rationale: Recommended host; auto HTTPS; Framework Preset Vite, build npm run build, output dist.

nodes.label: SPA Rewrites at Host
nodes.rationale: Serve manifest, icons and service worker without rewriting them to HTML.

nodes.label: Commit Message Conventions
nodes.rationale: Prefixes: Add, Update, Fix, Refactor, Docs, Style.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions CI/CD
nodes.rationale: Secrets for VITE_* keys go under Settings → Secrets and Variables → Actions.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages
nodes.rationale: Static only; requires base: /PopCornPal/ in vite.config.ts and gh-pages branch.

nodes.label: SPA Rewrites
nodes.rationale: Client-side routes 404 on refresh unless the host rewrites every path to /index.html (vercel.json rewrites or public/_redirects).

nodes.label: Env Secrets Policy
nodes.rationale: .env holds Supabase/API secrets and must never be committed; .env.example is the committed template; .env, .env.local, .env.production, node_modules and dist stay in .gitignore. If .env slips in: git rm --cached .env.

nodes.label: Collection View
nodes.rationale: Separates filtering/sorting from presentation and its editor; poster and list views, type filters, search, rating/editing, removal; editor shows save failures and requires a deliberate removal choice.

nodes.label: Cover Loading Wrappers
nodes.rationale: Fill poster/thumbnail frames even for landscape game art; feed photos and GIFs keep natural proportions, centered within bounded dimensions; composer previews scale proportionally.

nodes.label: Episode Ratings
nodes.rationale: Shows can be rated per episode; partial saves keep only unfinished episode ratings in the draft.

nodes.label: Repository-wide ESLint Debt
nodes.rationale: Older profile/feed/query components still report lint issues; do not describe lint as fully green.

nodes.label: Hosting Prerequisites
nodes.rationale: Steps before sharing a hosted URL: real env keys, verify schema/RLS/storage/get_feed RPC on staging, configure auth redirects, host dist behind HTTPS with SPA rewrites, device-test on iOS/Android, resolve advisories and lint debt.

nodes.label: Logging Sheet
nodes.rationale: One mobile sheet with abortable cached catalog queries, visible search/server errors, validated account-scoped drafts, local calendar dates, resume/discard actions and accurate online/offline success feedback; search stays available after saving.

nodes.label: Mobile PWA Redesign
nodes.rationale: Implemented on branch codex/mobile-pwa-redesign; keeps React, Vite, Supabase, TanStack Query and Zustand; nothing deployed or submitted to an app store.

nodes.label: PWA Icons and Manifest
nodes.rationale: Proper 192px, 512px, Apple touch and dedicated maskable icons replace the incomplete placeholder set; manifest has stable ID, shortcuts, consistent branding and standalone display; zoom enabled and safe-area padding retained.

nodes.label: Radial Launcher Menu
nodes.rationale: One launcher centered in the phone viewport opens a labeled radial menu (Logging on top; Home, People, You, Library, Activity around it). Built as a native modal dialog with focus trapping, arrow-key navigation, Escape/backdrop dismissal and focus restoration; desktop uses the same destination model in its header.

nodes.label: Mobile PWA Redesign
nodes.rationale: Cinematic redesign: central radial launcher, focused logging sheet, account-scoped offline data, responsive collection.

nodes.label: App Composition Root
nodes.rationale: App.tsx shrank from a 658-line coordinator to a small composition root; routes/session gating, lifecycle, connectivity, chunk recovery and PWA updates each have separate owners under src/app.

nodes.label: Logged Records Semantics
nodes.rationale: `logged` records form the durable collection; completed/in-progress/planned records represent activity. Existing data semantics preserved.

nodes.label: Viewport Meta
nodes.rationale: interactive-widget=resizes-content shrinks the viewport when the on-screen keyboard opens so bottom sheets sized in dvh stay reachable; user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1 lock proportions like a native app; viewport-fit=cover for safe areas.

nodes.label: .env
nodes.rationale: VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY; variable names must start with VITE_; restart dev server after editing.

nodes.label: Security
nodes.rationale: RLS policies in Supabase, Supabase Auth, API keys in env vars, HTTPS enforced, React XSS protection.

nodes.label: Supabase API Credentials
nodes.rationale: Project URL + anon public key from Settings → API.

nodes.label: profiles table
nodes.rationale: Username, bio, avatar.

nodes.label: Row Level Security
nodes.rationale: Users can only edit their own data.

nodes.label: Supabase Project
nodes.rationale: Free tier; region closest to users.

nodes.label: VITE_* Values Are Public
nodes.rationale: VITE_* variables ship to the browser; never put a Supabase service-role key there.

nodes.label: Supabase anon key
nodes.rationale: The anon key is safe to expose in frontend code; never use the service_role key in the client.

nodes.label: Browser Support
nodes.rationale: Chrome/Edge recommended, Safari iOS 14+, Firefox, Samsung Internet; Opera has limited PWA support.

nodes.label: Friend Badges
nodes.rationale: Shown for mutual follows.

nodes.label: Installing on Your Phone
nodes.rationale: iOS Safari: Share → Add to Home Screen; Android Chrome: menu → Install app.

nodes.label: PopcornPal
nodes.rationale: A social platform for tracking and sharing movies, TV shows, games and books; inspired by Letterboxd, Goodreads and Spotify Wrapped. Early-stage project under MIT license.

nodes.label: Progressive Web App
nodes.rationale: Offline support and installability on phones; HTTPS is required for installation so testing on a phone needs the deployed URL or same-WiFi dev server.

nodes.label: PWA Icons
nodes.rationale: Placeholder icon files in /public must be replaced with real PNGs (192x192, 512x512, 180x180 apple-touch) using a popcorn emoji or red/pink gradient logo; realfavicongenerator / pwabuilder recommended.

nodes.label: Physical Device Testing
nodes.rationale: iOS Safari and Android Chrome: keyboard, safe areas, low connectivity, update acceptance, realtime events, optional push; Chromium automation does not replace this.

nodes.label: iOS Web App Meta Tags
nodes.rationale: apple-mobile-web-app-capable, black-translucent status bar, title "Popcorn Pal".

nodes.label: Icon Generator Tools
nodes.rationale: realfavicongenerator.net (all sizes) and pwabuilder.com/imageGenerator (PWA-specific).

nodes.label: Placeholder PWA Icons
nodes.rationale: pwa-192x192.png, pwa-512x512.png and apple-touch-icon.png (180x180) are placeholders; production needs real PNGs at those sizes.

nodes.label: HTTPS Requirement for PWA
nodes.rationale: PWAs require a secure context; Vercel/Netlify provide HTTPS automatically, so test installation on the deployed URL, not a localhost IP.

nodes.label: Saved Checkout Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: The saved checkout had uncommitted changes in useAddEntryPage.ts, AddEntryPage.tsx, AuthPage.tsx and index.css whose intent was carried forward; integrate deliberately, do not overwrite a newer checkout wholesale.

nodes.label: Profile Customization
nodes.rationale: Profile pictures or GIF avatars, Giphy links, Currently Enjoying section, stats.

nodes.label: Database Migrations
nodes.rationale: Run in order after the main schema: avatar-url, image-url, nested-comments, notifications-schema, performance-indexes.

nodes.label: Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Phases 1-3 (foundation, media tracking, social) complete; Phase 4 future: year-end recap, lists, recommendations, social login, DMs, achievements, export.

nodes.label: /auth/callback route
nodes.rationale: Email confirmation links landed on a path the SPA did not serve, giving a 404; a dedicated route reusing AuthPage handles the confirmation token exchange and redirects to /feed, or shows the auth page if no session exists.

nodes.label: PopcornPal Header/Logo Exporter
nodes.rationale: Standalone canvas tool: presets 400x100, 800x200, 256, 512 with transparent/dark/white background.

nodes.label: PopcornPal Header Exporter
nodes.rationale: Exports the exact desktop navbar wordmark; presets 300x80, 400x100, 800x200, 512x512.

nodes.label: Supabase Redirect URLs
nodes.rationale: Authentication → URL Configuration must list http://localhost:5173/auth/callback and https://pop-corn-pal.vercel.app/auth/callback.

nodes.label: {{ .ConfirmationURL }}
nodes.rationale: Supabase Go-template variable injected as the CTA link and plain fallback link.

nodes.label: Popcorn Bucket Email Design
nodes.rationale: Layered SVG popcorn circles (#fef3c7/#fde68a) sit atop a red→pink trapezoid bucket made with clip-path; dark gray body (#111827/#1f2937) mirrors the app UI.

nodes.label: Canvas PNG Export
nodes.rationale: canvas.toDataURL("image/png") on an anchor with download attribute; filename encodes size and background.

nodes.label: Canvas Popcorn Bucket Icon
nodes.rationale: Simplified trapezoid bucket with #ef4444→#dc2626 gradient and three #fef3c7 popcorn circles, next to a #f87171 "PopcornPal" wordmark.

nodes.label: Gradient "PopcornPal" Wordmark
nodes.rationale: Text-only logo filled with a horizontal #ef4444→#ec4899 gradient in bold system font.

nodes.label: User Authentication
nodes.rationale: Sign up / sign in / sign out with email and password (min 6 chars).

nodes.label: Username Rules
nodes.rationale: 3-30 chars, lowercase, numbers, underscores; must be unique.

nodes.label: Confirm Email Template
nodes.rationale: Supabase auth email template; inline styles, table layout for email-client compatibility.

nodes.label: Email Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Supabase sends a confirmation link automatically; it prevents spam accounts and can be disabled in Authentication → Settings for testing.

nodes.label: Comment Images Feature
nodes.rationale: Users upload images/GIFs or paste image URLs into comments and nested replies, with inline display and preview before posting.

nodes.label: image_url column
nodes.rationale: Added to post_comments with an index for faster queries of comments with images.

nodes.label: Nested Comment Threads
nodes.rationale: Comment replies nest up to 5 levels.

nodes.label: Cinema Ticket Palette
nodes.rationale: Charcoal, coral and warm paper palette plus a cinema ticket motif give the app its own identity across feed, auth, logging and collection. No new discussion backend; friends keep sharing topics in posts/comments.

nodes.label: Favicon Version Tag
nodes.rationale: Desktop browsers cache a favicon by URL for a very long time; the ?v=2 query tag makes tabs still drawing the old mark fetch the new one. PNG fallbacks are provided for browsers that will not take the SVG, so desktop shows the same bucket as the phone.

nodes.rationale: Profiles loaded slowly because the page fetched the entire media library, followers list, and following list up front regardless of whether the user opened them. nodes.label: Supabase
nodes.rationale: Recommended over Firebase as the backend.

nodes.label: Supabase as Authentication Authority
nodes.rationale: Supabase owns auth; Zustand stores only display-profile data. One initialization promise and one auth listener replace duplicate listeners; profile requests run outside the auth callback; identity generations prevent stale responses from overwriting a new account.

nodes.label: Validation Suite
nodes.rationale: 15 Node regression tests, 15 Playwright browser/PWA tests, TypeScript production build, git diff --check. Browser suite builds the PWA, serves on port 4173 with fixture keys, intercepts backend data in isolated contexts and never touches the real Supabase project; the test build is not deployable.

nodes.label: Test Suite
nodes.rationale: npm test for regression tests; npm run test:e2e for the isolated production-browser/PWA suite (needs npx playwright install chromium).

nodes.label: Code Style
nodes.rationale: TypeScript for safety, focused reusable components, meaningful names, comments for complex logic.

nodes.label: Pull Request Workflow
nodes.rationale: Fork, feature branch, test thoroughly, clear commit message, push, open PR.

nodes.label: Testing Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Test on Chrome/Safari/Firefox, mobile/tablet/desktop, and verify PWA features.

nodes.label: Branching Strategy
nodes.rationale: feature/* branches merged to main via pull request.

nodes.label: MDN Offline and Background Operation Guide
nodes.norm_label: mdn offline and background operation guide

nodes.label: Account-Scoped Offline Queue
nodes.rationale: Query persistence and offline changes are partitioned by account. Atomic IndexedDB queue updates prevent enqueue/flush races; failed/auth-rejected changes stay saved; reconnect replay is serialized, across windows where Web Locks exists; mutation callbacks run offline so the queue actually receives writes.

nodes.label: Offline Support Limits
nodes.rationale: Auth and new catalog searches need connectivity; background replay needs an open/restored window; legacy global queue records without a trustworthy owner are preserved but never replayed under a guessed account; server-generated inserts are not exactly-once after ambiguous failures (server-side idempotency is future work); without Web Locks only same-window replay dedup.

nodes.label: Service Worker Update Policy
nodes.rationale: New service workers wait for a user-requested reload; already-viewed cover images can be cached; sw.js must not be cached indefinitely; the SW signals windows rather than executing authenticated writes itself.

nodes.label: Native Giphy Integration
nodes.rationale: Before: users left the app for Giphy.com, copied a URL, and pasted it back (5+ steps). A native picker modal keeps users in-app with one click, trending + search, and a purple theme consistent with the app.

nodes.label: Giphy Free Tier Rate Limits
nodes.rationale: 42 requests per hour per IP; enough for testing, consider upgrading for production.

nodes.label: VITE_GIPHY_API_KEY
nodes.rationale: Free key from developers.giphy.com; must be an "API" app, not SDK; dev server restart required.

nodes.label: Native GIF Picker
nodes.rationale: Modal overlay with Giphy Grid; trending on open; search; 3-column responsive grid; integrated in posts, comments and replies.

nodes.label: Giphy Dependency Advisories
nodes.rationale: Remaining advisories are in Giphy transitive js-cookie and uuid; do not force-downgrade the Giphy component package as a blind audit fix.

nodes.label: GIF Picker State
nodes.rationale: Three separate booleans (showPostGifPicker, showCommentGifPicker, showReplyGifPicker) prevent modal conflicts between posts, comments, and replies; each picker has its own onSelect callback setting the matching uploaded-image state.

nodes.label: Prop Drilling to CommentThread
nodes.rationale: CommentThread receives GIF picker state as props so nested replies share the same state.
